role: Entity renderer for EntityEnderCrystal: binds endercrystal.png and draws ModelEnderCrystal with the bobbing/rotation driven by innerRotation, shadow size 0.5. Despite the tileentity package it extends Render, not TileEntitySpecialRenderer.

members.name: enderCrystalTextures
members.note: the texture is loaded from csrc/assets/mobs/endercrystal.rgba (and endercrystal_beam.rgba for the beam), a pre-converted copy of the same PNG

members.name: field_76995_b
members.note: ModelEnderCrystal's geometry is built in the raster_mobs.c crystal pass (its comment names RenderEnderCrystal.doRender and ModelEnderCrystal.render)

members.name: RenderEnderCrystal
members.note: shadowSize 0.5 and the model are folded into the crystal pass

members.name: doRender
members.note: innerRotation bob (sin(var10*0.2)/2+0.5 plus its square) and var10*3.0 rotation, GL_CULL_FACE stays on

members.name: getEntityTexture
members.note: doRender binds enderCrystalTextures itself (RenderEnderCrystal.java:35); nothing calls bindEntityTexture on this renderer (lane/covclient)

notes: The beam to the crystal is drawn by the same native pass (raster_mobs.c endercrystal_beam texture; scene out/java/render/mobs2b_beam_f011). The ender-crystal explosion itself is EndDragonFight logic, not this renderer.
